review_time: No statistics published. Stated targets: action editor assigned within 1 week; reviews due 2 weeks after assignment for <=12 pages of main text (4 weeks if longer); reviewer recommendations 2 weeks after all reviews are in. No end-to-end target stated.
page_limit: No fixed limit (length must be justified by content); main text over 12 pages doubles the review window.
oa_cost: Free: no fees for authors; free to read; CC BY 4.0, authors keep copyright.

Per-author yearly submission quota. J2C track: TMLR papers published since Jan 1, 2025 (2-year window) with a J2C, Featured or Outstanding certification can be presented at NeurIPS/ICLR/ICML; not a proceedings publication.
